q: In a Firebase app, the only authorization layer between client and database is …
why: Rules decide who may read and write.

q: Rules are filters: a query for all notes returns only the ones you own.
why: Myth. The query must be provably allowed; filter by owner in the query.

q: Why does the example have a separate create rule?
o: On a new document, resource is null
why: A combined rule using resource.data would fail on create.

q: What does the Admin SDK do with rules?
why: That is why the service-account key is so sensitive.
